title: Rabbi Chiyya of Kefar Chanun
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Bereshit Rabbah 6:5: “Rabbi Yehoshua son of Rabbi Tanchuma son of Rabbi Chiyya of Kefar Chanun was in Asya,” etc. But this statement is in Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:6, and there: Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Tanchum of Kefar Agin; Kohelet Rabbah 3:2 reads Rabbi Yehoshua son of Rabbi Tanchum of Kefar Agun.

notes.text: ב״ר חייא is read as בר׳ חייא, “son of Rabbi Chiyya”; ר״ת in the Kohelet Rabbah reading is rendered Rabbi Tanchum.
